predecessors.name: Samma dynasty
predecessors.text: Sindh, taken by Shah Beg Arghun in the 1520 campaign that 'marked the end of Samma rule in Sindh'

predecessors.name: Langah Sultanate
predecessors.text: Multan, which 'fell in 1528 after an extended siege'

successors.name: Tarkhan Dynasty
successors.text: Sindh, which the Tarkhan dynasty 'ruled from 1554'; 'Muhammad 'Isa Tarkhan would keep lower Sindh, with his capital at Thatta' while Sultan Mahmud ruled upper Sindh from Bakhar

ledger.x: 1520: Jam Feroz is beaten and Thatta sacked.
1520: Shah Beg Arghun founds the Arghun dynasty in Sindh.
1525: the Arghuns move on Multan (bridging year).
1530 (bridging year): Multan is lost to rebels.
ledger.cp: Langah rebels of Multan (Sultan Mahmud II)

wars.name: Arghun conquest of Sindh
wars.outcome: Shah Beg Arghun defeats Jam Feroz, sacks Thatta and ends Samma rule in Sindh.

wars.name: Arghun conquest of Multan
wars.outcome: Multan falls in 1528 after an extended siege and an Arghun governor is installed; the city is lost again within about two years.

wars.name: Tarkhan seizure of power in Sindh
wars.outcome: After a civil war between Shah Husayn Arghun and his nobles under Muhammad 'Isa Tarkhan, the Tarkhans rule Sindh from 1554 and Shah Husayn is set aside.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a frontier of the Arghun domain; Sindh is drawn as Cliopatria's Samma outline and Multan as a radius.
